title: Order confirmation emails not sent
alert: notification queue depth 52,000 and rising; customer anita.s@gmail.com got no confirmation
root cause: A deploy changed the email template id and the notifier kept failing and requeuing
fix: Rolled back the template change and drained the queue with a rate limit

title: Product pages hanging
alert: Product pages waiting 8s on reco-service; support line 9876012345 flooded
root cause: Product pages called reco-service synchronously with no timeout
fix: Added a 300ms timeout with a circuit breaker and a static fallback list

title: Items oversold during sale
alert: 412 orders placed for items that were already out of stock during a flash sale
root cause: Two services decremented stock without a lock, so concurrent orders sold the same unit
fix: Switched to an atomic stock decrement with a 10-minute reservation

title: Card payments failing at checkout
alert: payment-bridge gateway returned 502 for 12% of card payments
root cause: The primary card gateway had a partial outage and the failover flag had been left off after a test
fix: Turned on automatic failover to the secondary gateway and added an alert when the flag is off

title: Shipping labels not generating
alert: logistics-bridge QuickDrop API returning 500 for label creation; 2,300 orders waiting
root cause: QuickDrop had an outage and our client retried in a tight loop
failed fixes: Retrying label creation in a loop
fix: Switched new shipments to the secondary courier and queued the rest with backoff

title: Search returning no products
alert: search-api zero-result rate 71%; products alias document count far below normal
root cause: The nightly reindex failed halfway but still switched the products alias to the new index
failed fixes: Rebuilding the whole index from scratch (took 2 hours)
fix: Pointed the products alias back to the previous index and re-ran the reindex with the alias switch disabled
